_metadata.description: Lifestyle Dashboard requirement registry - Parent-level requirements reference child modules declared under imports

requirements.title: Shared event schema and SQLite storage
requirements.description: SQLite events table with JSON payloads, common envelope (id UUID, timestamp ISO-8601, domain, event_type, payload JSON), indexed by domain+timestamp, extensible without migrations. Includes causality markers: is_intervention (bool), hypothesis_id (UUID nullable).

requirements.title: Domain registration and discovery
requirements.description: Dynamic domain scenario registration via API, capability exposure, health status tracking. Domains can start/stop independently.

requirements.title: Cross-domain query API
requirements.description: API endpoints for querying events across domains with time-range filters, domain filters, basic aggregations, and correlation queries.

requirements.title: Unified dashboard UI
requirements.description: Mobile-first responsive design. Timeline view across all domains, per-domain collapsible sections with deep-dive links, trend charts (7d/30d/90d), daily Lifestyle Score display.

requirements.title: Daily brief system
requirements.description: Morning brief (7am default: what to do today, experiments in progress, yesterday summary) and evening review (9pm default: what happened, compliance rates, tomorrow preview) consolidated from all active domains.

requirements.title: Storage management UI
requirements.description: Settings page showing database size and large files, ability to clean all or selected data, manage large files. Typical storage management operations.

requirements.title: Correlation engine
requirements.description: Automated statistical correlation analysis across domains with significance tracking (p-value, confidence interval). Configurable minimum threshold (default: 14 data points). 'Needs more data' indicator for insufficient samples.

requirements.title: Weekly digest
requirements.description: 'What Changed?' summary every Sunday (6pm default) comparing current week to rolling 4-week baseline. Shows deltas, new correlations discovered, medium-term trends.

requirements.title: Composite Lifestyle Score
requirements.description: Daily 0-100 score combining all active domains. Weights configurable (sleep heavy, socialization light). Trajectory visualization over time. No gamification.

requirements.title: Experiment framework
requirements.description: N=1 experiments with hypothesis, intervention, measurement, duration, compliance tracking, and outcome reports. Leverages causality markers (is_intervention, hypothesis_id).

requirements.title: Notification consolidation
requirements.description: Central scheduler collecting domain notifications into minimal daily touchpoints. Reduces alert fatigue while preserving actionable information.

requirements.title: Medical export
requirements.description: Comprehensive PDF health reports combining all domain data for healthcare providers. Includes trends, correlations, and experiment results with selectable data ranges.

requirements.title: Natural language queries
requirements.description: Ollama-powered questions against event data. Support questions like 'How has my sleep been this month?' and 'What changed when I started creatine?'
